_doc: Ordered build queue for scripts/agent_loop.py. Mirrors SPEC §17 P0. Each task runs two phases: (A) write the oracle tests from the spec, then freeze them; (B) implement until the frozen tests pass. Edit this file by hand only.

tasks.title: levels, rule registry, derived fields, limits
tasks.notes: Robert expectations are spelled out in §15 (life_stage pre_retirement, ef_months 4.6, effective_horizon 3.6, capacity low_moderate, effective low_moderate, knowledge.score 74, limits == the fixture's `limits` block). limits_trace must be generated from the registry, never hand-written. The rules may read the v1 Robert fixture for now: P0.3 converts it.

tasks.title: profile v2 JSON Schema + Robert fixture conversion
tasks.notes: Test: fixtures/robert/profile.json validates against schemas/profile.v2.json (draft 2020-12); meta.schema_version == 2; every llm: object has prompt_version/model_id/updated_at/input_hash; behavioural evidence is [{event_id, signal, note}] and every event_id exists in events.jsonl; values.parsed_notes quotes are exact substrings of values.notes; events match §16 ids/dates/texts; intent in_0001 == NVDA 10% funded from ZST.TO. test_rules.py must still pass after the conversion.

tasks.title: hard checks H1-H10, H14 + report verdict
tasks.notes: P0 covers Robert only. Robert baseline: H1-H6 pass (fixed income 0.35, max single stock RY 0.07, foreign ccy 0.27, crypto 0). Robert + NVDA 10% from ZST: H3 violation (0.10 > 0.08), H4 violation (0.25 < 0.30), H5 pass (0.37 <= 0.40), verdict incoherent. Every check result has the §7.3 keys and only hard checks may emit violation. Amira/Mateo cases are P1: do not write them now.

tasks.title: intent.apply + resizer
tasks.notes: intent.apply for every funding.kind keeps weights summing to 1 and never goes negative. Resizer per docs/spec-decisions.md D2: run §8 as written and assert the values the engine actually produces (Robert NVDA from ZST: expected below 5.0% with H9 binding, p5_T < 360000 at 5%; pro-rata equities: record measured max and binding check). Record them as golden values with the measured numbers in a comment. No skip marks.

tasks.title: bedrock wrapper (mock/record/live), N1 + N4 schemas/prompts, gate
tasks.notes: No network in tests: COHERENCE_ANALYZER_LLM=mock reads fixtures/llm_cache only and raises LLMCacheMiss on a miss. Cache key = existing cache_key(). Hand-write llm_cache responses for Robert's N1 and N4 calls that pass the schemas (§16), keyed by the real cache_key of the real payload. Gate cases from §15: invented event_id -> rejected:evidence; quote not in notes -> rejected:evidence; behavioural low_moderate -> high is clamped to moderate; abstain keeps the old value. boto3 is imported lazily, only in record/live mode.

tasks.title: five factors: mapping, factor modules, report sections, template_section, numcheck
tasks.notes: Factor modules are views: do not move or change rules/ or coherence/hard.py. CHECK_FACTOR covers H1-H14, S1-S4, G1, O1 exactly once (table in §20.2). Measured on the real code (hard.run_all, engine.analyse(market, engine.ROBERT_NVDA, 48, 400000), profile derived with as_of 2026-11-12): non-pass checks are H3, H4, H7, H8, H9, H10 violation and H6, H10 unknown. So sections: horizon violation, risque violation, contraintes violation, objectif pass, preferences pass; Robert baseline: contraintes unknown (H6, H10), all others pass, verdict coherent. Section facts pre-format numbers in fr-CA ('13,4 %', '360 000 $'). template_section(facts) is deterministic and its text passes numcheck against its own facts. numcheck accepts '7,4 %', '7.4%', '360 000 $', '$360,000'; rejects a number not in the payload; small integer counts <= 10 exempt. No LLM in this task.

tasks.title: narration loop: N5 explainer per section, verifier V1-V5, retry once, template fallback
tasks.notes: Use the P0.6 bedrock.call_tool and cache_key; tests run in mock mode only. Hand-write llm_cache entries for Robert + NVDA's three non-pass sections (horizon, risque, contraintes): one good (mode llm), one bad-then-good (llm_retry; the retry payload carries retry_failures so it has its own cache key), one bad twice (template). Each verifier rule V1-V5 has its own rejecting test case. pass sections must not call the LLM (assert via a call counter, or that no cache lookup happens). explanation.headline is template text; disclaimer is the fixed config text; explanation.mode is the worst section mode.

tasks.title: pipeline Flow A (rules + N3) and Flow C review + cli review/demo (Robert review end-to-end offline)
tasks.notes: Per D7: Flow A = rules only plus N3 values_parser through the gate (no N1/N2 in the pipeline; their code stays). Flow C = engine.analyse(current) -> hard checks + S2/S4 -> verdict -> five sections -> narration loop -> report + audit. Add fixtures/robert/portfolio_review.json holding the engine.ROBERT_NVDA weights (do not modify fixtures/robert/portfolio.json, frozen tests read it). Acceptance: `cli review fixtures/robert --portfolio portfolio_review.json` in mock mode writes a schema-valid report: verdict incoherent; 5 sections in display order objectif, horizon, risque, contraintes, preferences; statuses horizon/risque/contraintes violation, objectif/preferences pass; every check has a factor key; narration modes recorded per section; audit record has model_id and per-section modes. `cli review fixtures/robert` (current portfolio) gives verdict coherent with H6/H10 in unknowns. Running twice gives byte-identical reports except run_id/timestamps. `demo` runs personas with complete fixtures and prints a notice for the rest. Flow B is P2: do not wire it.

tasks.title: intake form per factor (deterministic) + N3 values_parser schema/prompt + parsed-rule approval
tasks.notes: Runs in parallel with P0.7-P0.9: do NOT edit coherence_analyzer/factors/ (P0.7 owns it); keep the REQUIRED checklist per factor as a dict in intake.py (REQUIRED: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] keyed by the five factor ids), P0.9 will wire it into the factor modules. intake.missing(profile, factor) and intake.next_question(profile, factor) are pure; questions are fixed fr-CA/en-CA templates per REQUIRED path (no LLM). Robert fixture: missing() is empty for every factor; removing a REQUIRED path makes next_question return that path's question; a skip stores {value: null, by: 'user:skipped'}. N3 in mock mode on Robert's values.notes returns rules whose quote is an exact substring (gate rejects otherwise); parsed rules start approved_by_user false; build_limits ignores unapproved rules and includes an approved max_theme_weight / exclude_activity (invariant 2: test_limits_no_llm_inputs stays green). A parsed max_theme_weight with no number makes next_question ask for the number. Never write data/meta/activity_tags.csv.

tasks.title: internal coherence: contradiction rules C1-C5 + N6 profile_consistency (schema/prompt/gate) + check_profile
tasks.notes: Runs in parallel with P0.9: do NOT edit pipeline.py, cli.py, store.py, coherence/report.py, explain.py or factors/ (wiring into the report is a later task). Tests must cover: Robert fixture (as_of 2026-11-12) -> rule_findings gives exactly one C1 (goal 'Help children with a down payment', 2032-01 vs horizon 4 years) and no C2-C5; each of C2-C5 fires on a minimal edited copy of Robert and C1-C5 skip silently when their fields are missing; C2 uses LIMITS_TABLE neighbours (Robert -12 at low_moderate is inside [-20, -8]); n6_payload has no {value, by} objects, no limits, no llm: fields, includes values.notes and the rule hits; gate profile_consistency accepts a good output, and rejects (whole output dropped, rejected:evidence) a made-up path, a {value,by} path, a quote that is not the value at its path, a notes quote that is not an exact substring, a single-field finding, and rejects (rejected:schema) a reason with a digit / advisory phrase / > 200 chars, or > 5 findings; abstain -> kept:abstain; statuses: contradiction->warning, tension->info, never violation; an N6 finding with the same path set as a C finding is dropped; check_profile in mock mode on Robert returns status warning with C1 first and the hand-written N6 tension (preferences.interests 'new_opportunities' vs values.notes 'No hype stocks unless I can explain the business.') as info; on LLMCacheMiss it returns the rule findings and llm.gate_status 'skipped:cache_miss'; every finding has fixed fr-CA/en-CA question templates (no LLM text in question); check_profile never mutates the profile and test_limits_no_llm_inputs stays green. Record the mock with scripts/handwrite_llm_cache.py (model id fixture:hand-written), as P0.10 did.

tasks.title: parallel factor lanes (thread pool in explain) + profile_coherence block in the Flow C report, audit and cli
tasks.notes: Do NOT change coherence/internal.py, gate.py, factors/ or any recorded llm_cache entry (all their tests stay green). Tests must cover: explain.explain runs the non-pass sections through a concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor (max_workers 5) and its output (mode, headline, segments, section order) is identical to a sequential run on the Robert review (monkeypatch narrate_section with a recorder / a sleep to prove overlap: total wall time well under the sum of per-section sleeps); an exception in one section's narration does not lose the others (that section falls back to the template, as for LLMCacheMiss); pass sections still make no LLM call. pipeline.review adds report['profile_coherence'] = internal.check_profile(profile, as_of) result's {status, findings} (as_of = portfolio.as_of, D1) for every Flow C report; on Robert it is status warning with C1 then N6.1; it never changes report['verdict'] or any section status (compare with check_profile monkeypatched to return 3 warnings); the audit record gets the N6 call log and gate status (llm_calls entry with node profile_consistency); report.json schema accepts the new block (required); cli review / demo print one line 'profile: warning (C1, N6.1)'. Reports stay deterministic apart from run_id (inv. 8).
